balls.text: good straight drive, but this is a run-out because he has got a finger on it on its way to the stumps at the striker's end. Don't expect the non-striker to be in the crease at this time either. They have not yet decided on this, but Irfan has already thrown his pads off and has started bowling some looseners. Given out finally, and correctly
this is better, yorker outside off, steered to third man
length ball, heaved away, gets four wide of square leg. Not great bowling
poor delivery, down the leg side with fine leg up, and even though Pathan doesn't get bat on it, he will take four leg-byes
steered to third man for a single, brings Pathan on strike
well bowled, yorker angled across him, can't quite reach it

comes down the track, chips him over his head, takes one, wants two, decides against it, sees Jadeja fumble, wants two, decides against it. Rightly so, because Jadeja's return hits the stumps at the striker's end on the full
full across him, driven to sweeper-cover for one
slog-sweep, but Powar is delightfully slow through the air, and Birt is that half a second early into the shot, skying it to deep midwicket
yorker again, Pathan digs it out for one
no justice for the bowler. He sees Pathan comes down, pulls the length ball, beats him in the flight, but that bat is so good the mis-hit carries for a six over cow corner
yorks him up first ball
this is not that clever from Vinay. One slower ball too many, Birt gets down on a knee and lofts back over his head for a six

They finally get Sehwag out. Well worked-out dismissal. Vinay goes round the wicket, has long-on, deep extra, and sweeper-cover, and angles the ball across hi. It is a slower ball, and he doesn't get his all on this shot towards extra cover, and picks the man on the boundary. Top innings, though - 49 off the last 15 balls he faced
looks for the pull bit it is not short enough, but he manages a single to midwicket
lucky runs... Comes down the track, is yorked by Vinay, but the thick edge beats short third man
slower ball, shortish outside off, and it rolls along the pitch. Shooter, not the first one either
length ball outside off, and Birt joins the party, lofting this over extra cover. There was enough room for him to free his arms
Beautiful. One of the best shots you can see. Inside-out over extra cover, after stepping down to get to the pitch of the ball
yorks him up this time

Looked like a mis-hit! You wouldn't say it, though, if you saw it land metres behind the fence. He wasn't quite close to the pitch of the ball, it was closer to the top edge than to the middle, but it cleared long-on easily
a touch too full, chipped to long-off for one
nice offbreak, middle and leg line, pushed to straightish extra cover
Powar has been imperious in the field today, and dives across to his right to prevent a single. It was a full toss that Birt missed out on, though
Another beaut from Sehwag. This is not a great delivery, though. Full, middle, and whipped over midwicket for another four
driven square, gets a single, hands the strike over to the man who should have the strike
hit in the air, not in control, but it bounces in front of long-off
How is he doing it? Backs away, and cuts this off leg-stump line, past backward point. And remember this is a wicket where 99 of 100 batsmen will find stroke-play difficult
wide outside off, border-line case, and Sehwag doesn't go for it
Viru! This is incredible. Slow pitch, low bounce, who cares? Just comes forward, goes inside-out, gets his arm through, and sends a length ball over long-off. Easy
Slower ball slips out, so high is the full toss that Parthiv, standing up, has to jump. All he manages is a hand on it to save four byes
hit wide off Powar again, they look for a second, but you don't risk a second off Powar in this fielding form
and nicely opens the face on the first delivery he faces. Powar makes a sensational diving save at third man

another slower ball, too full, though, and driven wide of sweeper-cover. There was a couple in here, but Nagar was always slow, especially when starting out for the second. Consequently, an accurate and flat throw from Jadeja catches him short
slower full ball, driven down to long-on for one
and it gets better as Sehwag late-cuts this delivery that stays low, from almost in front of the stumps, past short third man

Slower bouncer, on target, between chest and chin, over the top of middle. Doesn't matter to Sehwag. he doesn't commit to an shot, then waits and waits, and then pulls him into the second tier behind midwicket. Fifty up too. Lovely innings
makes room, cuts this wide of sweeper-cover, gets a couple
accurate delivery around off, pushed to cover
short of a length, middle and leg, pushed down to long-on for one
moves across a bit to work this to on side
slightly short of a length, hit to mid-off
low bounce outside off again, can't do much with this
The old trick. Charge down and hit a spinner for a six, and stay back to hit a short ball next ball. Jadeja does as Sehwag expects, going flat and short, and he pulls him over cow corner another six

Sehwag is playing a bit of a gem here. top shot this time, coming down the track, making the slightest bit of room to free his arms, going inside-out over long-off, into the Kochi dugout. Insult to the bowler, and possible injury to the reserve players if they are not watching
fuller this time, and pushed down to long-off
makes room and cuts, powerfully, but the pitch is slow, and he gets a bottom edge back to Jadeja
full on the pads, nicely placed on the on side to come back for two
cramps him up as he looks to make room, pretty quick delivery

Superb fielding by Vinay, although it is always going to be in vain. Good inswinger first of all, inside edge hits the pad, rolls back onto the pitch, they steal a single, but Vinay is quick in swooping onto the ball, and under-arming it into the stumps. Sehwag is in, though
looking to force this through covers, gets an inside edge square on the on side
full delivery, driven down to long-on for one
slower ball, sees it early, comes forward, makes room, and hits it wide of extra cover. Top shot. Valuable runs
bouncer, stays away from it
back of a length, accurate, pushed to midwicket
arm ball again, goes back, gets a single to midwicket
comes forward to defend this
wide down the leg side, beats the keeper, and Powar makes a diving save after chasing the ball from short fine leg
slower through the air, pushed down to long-on
lucky there. Jadeja bowls the arm ball as Nagar looks to make room, gets a glove from outside leg, and it beats the keeper
chipped towards long-on for a single
inside edge as he looks force this through cover
slower ball, around off and just outside, pushed back to the bowler
full on the pads, worked away for a single
sharp short delivery, chest-high, Sehwag plays it towards backward point
slower ball, but outside off, and it's easier to negotiate the low bounce and place it past cover
slightly fuller, slightly closer to the stumps, defends off the back foot
starts back of a length outside off, punched away square, wide of third man, comes back for two
tossed up outside off, looks for drive over extra, the ball doesn't come on, and he ends up hitting it back to the bowler. Along the ground
comes down the rack, is hit on the pad as Jadeja fires it down
angling in, middle and leg, played to cover
comes forward, the ball doesn't turn and takes the inside edge, for a single towards short fine
another shooter, and Sehwag's bat comes down in time again, working this into the on side
short and wide, cut away to sweeper-cover for one
yorker, right on the crease, Nagar squeezes it out and breaks the maiden. Good spell from Sree: 4-1-10-2
slower legcutter, but doesn't turn enough and hits him on the pad outside the line of leg. They take another leg-bye
bouncer, sharp bouncer, Sehwag sways out of its line
stays low, Sehwag has to jam his bat down on this. He does well, because the line was straight
short ball, just outside off, gets right back to defend this
appeal for leg before, but again he is sliding down the leg side. They steal the leg-bye
tossed up outside off, and Nagar drives this square for a single
another push into the cover region
shorter, flatter, defended to cover
stretches well forward and outside off to defend this

Gone! Not the best of shot. Playing around the pad, and also playing for the turn. And Jadeja is not the biggest of turners of the ball. Pitches outside off, going straight with the arm, hitting him in front. Looks pretty straight, unless replays show that he was hit outside the line of off. And the relays show it hit him in line with off
flicked away off the pads, gets a single
good outswing bowling, just short of driving length, starting middle and leg, shaping towards off, takes the leading edge, which doesn't carry to cover
driving length Rao drives, but straight to Sree
stumps to stumps this time, defended to leg
slower legcutter. Pitches outside leg, and then rolls across, yes rolls across to the keeper
normal bounce, but headed down the leg side. Sree appeals, but half-heartedly
another surli, but down the leg side, concedes a leg-bye
comes forward to defend this
another incredible Sehwag shot. With hardy any room to work with, Sehwag rocks back and somehow generates enough power to send this shortish ball flying over cover
looks for the upper-cut, but misses

Sree has been good Sree with the ball, but bad Sree has let Sehwag off. Sehwag clips this towards short fine leg, it is hit gently, slightly in front of Sree, but he doesn't come in forward, and had time to do so. It bounces in front of him, and then through his legs. Many will say this is not a drop because he didn't get a hand to it, but to me it was a chance
regulation bounce this time, pushes a shortish delivery to cover
chips this over the infield on the leg side
Another special shot. He has cut this from around the fifth-stump line! With so little room, he has managed incredible power behind this shot
half-hearted shout for lbw, but this clearly headed down the leg side
they don't want to be doing this on this pitch. Low bounce, stay stumps to stumps, but this is a wide down the leg side
low bounce again, but it's outside off, and hard work for the keeper to collect it on the bounce
Lovely shot. Front foot down, slightly opening up the stance to maybe take the lbw out, and then driving a length ball with an open face. Finds the gap too
looking to drive through the covers, gets an inside edge onto the pad
Venu is well forward too to defend this length ball
Sehwag has seen balls keeping low at this end, and the first ball e faces he plants the front foot well down and off-drives for a single
clipped away off the pads for a single
punched away again, but straight to cover-point. Sehwag is frustrated he hasn't found the gap
not difficult if you bowl gentle length balls on Sehwag's pads. He flicks it away through midwicket
goes for the shot in the air, doesn't time it well, but clears the infield on the off side. Very difficult wicket to bat on
punched away square - the slowness of the pitch means it goes to cover-point and not squarer
hint of low bounce again, Sehwag opens the face to guide this to slip. On the bounce of course
more swing for Sree, and good bounce too. Defended back to him. Double-wicket maiden
this one bounces all right, left alone outside

What do you do Jack? This ball hasn't bounced at all. It's bowled back of a length, Ojha goes back to defend it, but it has almost rolled along the ground, hitting him on the boot. No wonder they use this ground more often for football. Good old surli, as we call it in gully cricket, or how Kapil Dev described Kirti Azad's effort to get Ian Botham in the 1983 World Cup semi-final
nearly another wicket for Sree. he is swinging the ball, and Ojha moves across along the crease, looking to play it to on. Soft hands mean the leading edge doesn't carry to Sree
and it is still good Sreesanth, length ball, in the channel of off, shaping away a bit, pushed to cover

It's the good Sreesanth first ball, even though it needs some low bounce. Sreesanth bowls short of a length, around middle and leg, and the ball doesn't get up and squeezes under Warner's bat. Off stump gone
swing there as RP pitches this full, Warner gets an inside edge square on the leg side for a single
looking for another cut, but has been cramped up a bit, and gets an underside edge
short and wide again, but Warner hasn't yet been able to find the placement. Early signs of slowness of the wicket. Can't quite place the ball
short and wide, cut away straight to backward, where Jadeja concedes two overthrows at the striker's end
slightly fuller, but not driving length, Warner stays back and pushes this to cover
short just outside off, forced away square, but can't beat cover-point
wide down the leg side, no hint of swing or straightening as this keeps going after pitching around leg
and it's all over. Vinay Kumar gets a thick edge on an intended big hit, and it lobs to point where Yadav takes an athletic catch
full on the pads, worked away for one

Taste of his own medicine for Sreesanth, who got two wickets with shooters, surlis himself. The boot is on the other foot as this pitches back of a length and hits the base of the off stump. Not much he could have done with this one
gets the yorker right this time, outside off, squeezing under his bat
Bowled him! No uneven bounce here, as it is a full toss that has gone straight through and hit the middle stump. Powar took half a step down the track, but was done in by this quick low full toss
Full toss hit straight down wide long-on's throat, but they are checkingnif this is too high a full toss. No it isn't, says the replay. Off you go, Ravindra
looks for the scoop, can't beat short fine leg
length ball on the pads, right in his slogging slot, and is smacked over square leg for six. First boundary off Agarkar tonight
another yorker, hit down to long-on for one
yorker, digs it out, steals the single
back of a length, around off, pushed back to the bowler
quick, straight, middle and off, played back wide of him
yorker on the pads, squeezed out to midwicket for one
arm ball, quick, really quick, on the stumps, defended
full toss on the pads, not the best of connections, but he gets enough on it to clear the deep midwicket by a couple of feet
full, on the pads, played to deep midwicket for one
length, on the pads, pushed down the ground
short, into the body, and a dot ball to end yet another superb spell from Morne
makes room and slogs this down to long-on for one
short outside leg, and whipped away fine. Would have been a wide had he not gone for it
looks to steal a single to cover, and was a goner had the throw hit
Too good, is Morkel. He is the only one getting extra bounce from this wicket. This one jumps from back of a length, and takes the edge as Akhil heaves away
Jadeja charges at him, gets a single to mid-off
driven back past the bowler for a single
pulled to wide mid-on for one
this is a better shot, but will get him just two. Keeps this pull down, and wide of midwicket
that's a mis-hit gone for six... Yadav's poor day continues. Just back of a length, Akhil slogs, and the toe end clears midwicket
short ball, gets a bit big on him, but he manages to clear midwicket
full, on off, hit back to the bowler
tries the old-fashioned slog this time, gets an inside edge for one
nasty little delivery, short of a length, quick, following him, doesn't know what to do
charges down, gets a thick edge, which falls just in front of Pathan at third man. Given his fielding for, would have been interesting to see if he would have caught this had it carried
open face on a delivery angled across him, one bounce to point
pushes in front of his body, gets a single to cover

No it isn't! This game is gone. Morkel comes back and bowls a peach to get Hodge out. Lovely bowling too, didn't need the wicket to do anything here. Back of a length, pitches off, moves away slightly, enough to take the edge
and it gets better as he upper-cuts this short and wide delivery. Not the best comeback from Pathan, who dropped Hodge five minutes ago. is this game alive still?
lovely shot, half volley all right, but he has wristed this between long-on and long-off. has bisected them. Good over so far
slower ball, the check shot goes in the air, but wide enough of Pathan
looks to heave over the on side, the inside edge gets him just the single to midwicket
slower ball, gets a single to midwicket
short and wide, gives him space to go through the shot, and he plays the cut in the air to clear the point fielder
doesn't come on again, Hodge has to check his shot, chipping it down to long-on for one
slower ball on the pads, another single to midwicket
bouncer, and beats him on the pull. One for the over
rskly single to short fine, Morkel can't hit direct, although Jadeja was quick enough
back of a length, on the pads, gets a single to midwicket
angled into the pads, gets a single
worked away towards midwicket for a single

Dropped by Pathan at long-on. Hodge danced down the track mis-hit it towards Pathan, it was a simple enough chance at a comfortable height, Pathan seemed to have it under control, but somehow it popped out
back of a length, punched down to long-off for another single
reverse-paddle this time, gets a single to short third
places a similar delivery well this time, takes the single
full on the pads, can't beat midwicket
opens the face on a length ball outside off, hits it straight to point
and uneven bounce in the outfield now. The point fielder gets the bounce this time. A single is taken

Mahela looks at the pitch with disgust. And he is not the first one on the night. Looks to chip this over midwicket, the ball doesn't come on at all, and he ends up lobbing it to midwicket. That's the game for Delhi
shortish, around off, pushed to sweeper-cover for one
looks to go over short fine, misses, but he has got the front pad outside the line of off
Mahela moves across, Ajit goes wide, ends up hitting it back to the bowler
this time Mahela goes even wider, and gets that single
what an effort. This is driven well to the left of VDM, but he flies across to make the diving save. To save one run
driven on the up, uppishly too, but it bounces well in front of extra cover
gets a bit too straight, and is worked away to deep midwicket
on target, short of driving length, middle and off, turning away just an inch, defended
full, chipped to long-on off the inside half of the bat
around off, back of a length, tipped past cover for one
sees him charge at him, goes short, into the legs, concedes just the single
well bowled, straightening after pitching around middle and off. Hodge gets the front edge, but straight into the ground
clipped away off the pads, wide of deep square, comes back for two
stump to stump, no room, but this doesn't misbehave, and he drops and runs
chips a length ball over midwicket. Nicely played
back of a length outside off, left alone by Hodge
full on the pads, worked away for an easy single
Stop the press. There is extra bounce on this pitch! Well done Morne. Just back of a length, just outside off, bouncing sharply. Did it hold its line too? Mahela does well by dropping his wrists
similar delivery, defended to point again
slightly short of driving length, outside off, defended. Needs to get straighter and shorter, because that's where it is misbehaving
shortish outside off, defended with an open face
stays back to block a straight delivery that stays a touch low again
fuller, straighter, defended with a straight bat
short and wide again, and Hodge has punched this and sent it careening past cover-point. Yadav has not been smart on this wicket
closer to the stumps now, Hodge can only go back and defend this
short outside off again, Hodge looks to pull, and is beaten by the lack of bounce
Umesh Yadav, though, is playing some other game. His poor stuff continues into his second over. Short and wide, received with gratitude by Hodge
covers the line of this one going across him, and opens the face to play it to point
angled across him, pushed to extra cover
gets off the mark with a clip off the pads
Call the hobbits. This is sneaking under Parthiv Patel's bat too. All you have to do is bowl short, and on the stumps, and watch the magic. Patel's off stump gone, and he is squatting SRT-style
length ball, on the pads, worked away on the on side
angled across Mahela, he pushes it to mid-off
short outside off, stays low again, bouncing in front of Ojha, they take a bye off the ricochet
back of a length, into the pads, played to square leg
length ball on the pads, and Mahela is batting beautifully, clipping this wide of square leg
bouncer, knee high! Good job for Mahela that this is outside off as he is beaten on the pull
driven on the up, nice shot again, but straight to mid-off
loosener down the leg side, and glanced away fine for four easy runs
short outside off, stays low again, Patel squats as he keeps this out
and the elegant cover drive of a full and wide delivery, can't beat Sehwag at cover, though
oh Mahela, well done. Stumps to stump, shooting low, headed for lbw, but Mahela jams the bat down in time
stays low again, but it is on the pads, and is easily helped away for one
good-looking drive, gets a single to cover

so does MCCullum. You can't fight this track this way. McCullum charges at Pathan again, assumingly to negate the low bounce, but Pthan pitches this short, and the ball stlll manages to sneak under the bat. Pitched half day the track, hitting the middle stump half way up. Go figure
and what does he do? Bowls short outside leg, and Ojha can't collect that

van der merwe you beauty! I was looking at the square-leg boundary as Klinger clipped this nicely off his pads. And in the way stood RVDM, who jumped at least as high as a goal post, and caught this in two hands. Lovely catch
and McCullum is dancing down the track again, hitting this wide of mid-off for another single
stands his ground, Morkel stays back of a length, defended to midwicket
Klinger jumps out of the crease too. They don't want to give it time to stay low. The inside edge goes to fine leg for a single
BMac charges at him, turning this shortish ball into a length delivery, hitting it to mid-on for one
Not if he bowls that full. McCullum check-drives this half-volley past Morkel for a straight four
some more swing, coming in from just outside off, defended towards cover
back of a length, around off, pushed to cover
looks to cut as this is angled across, the low bounce beats the bat, and it is too low for Ojha to collect cleanly
back of a length, drops this to on side and rushes through for one
more swing, coming from around off, Klinger comes forward to defend around his pad
swing right away, but they steal the single to short fine where van der Merwe fumbles a touch
